Jewel thief and smuggler extraordinaire, Dr. Xavier Tortion (aka Dr. X), is somewhere in Europe along with numerous jewels he's stolen. Your job is to find the jewels and locate Dr. X!

In the game you have to travel to various European countries and their famous locations to search for clues. You may travel only between adjacent countries on the map. Clues will be left behind by friendly agents and indicate where jewels are located. When you will come across an informant, he should be bribed with money or jewels to receive a clue, where Dr. X is. You only have 3 guesses to uncover Dr. X's hideout until the end of the game. If you are successful in your mission, you are given an efficiency rating; the fewer turns you can locate Dr. X in and the more jewels recovered, the better your score will be.

The game is available for one player, as well as two game modes for multiple players - cooperative "spy network" or "spy against spy". The progress may be saved and restored later. The best scores will be stored in top list.

424111.overview:
Dr. Xavier Tortion (aka Dr. X), jewel thief and smuggler extraordinaire, is on the loose; intelligence reports he is somewhere in North America along with numerous jewels he's stolen. Your job will be to find the jewels and locate Dr. X!

Adventures in North America is an educational adventure game which is similar to the Carmen Sandiego series of games. In the game you will need to travel to various North American locations to search for clues; some clues have been left behind by friendly agents and indicate where jewels are located. Sometimes you will come across an informant; if bribed with money or jewels, you will receive a clue as to Dr. X's where about. When you think you have enough clues, you can guess where Dr. X is hiding; you only get three guesses though, so if you keep guessing wrong the game will end. If you are successful in your mission, you are given an efficiency rating; the fewer turns you can locate Dr. X in and the more jewels recovered, the better your score will be.

424113.overview:
The third addition to the Spy's Adventures series is another geographical edutainment title, featuring the same combination of international travel and mystery-solving as the previous two installments, and similar to the contemporaneous Carmen Sandiego games. All-around bad guy Dr. Xavier Tortion (Dr. X for short) is up to his jewel-thieving antics once again, this time in South America, and must be tracked down along with his contraband. The game can be played in single-player mode, or up to 6 players may play cooperatively ("spy network") or competitively ("spy vs. spy").

The chase starts in a country of the player's choice, with a map of the continent, some money, and dossiers with basic information on the various countries. The player can travel from one country to its neighbors on the map. Each country offers at least one site to visit, and investigating the various locations will uncover clues to the whereabouts of jewels - informants will also be found, who can be paid off with money or jewels to provide crucial clues to Dr. X's hiding place. The goal is to guess his location in no more than 3 attempts, or he escapes and the quest comes to an end. If he is caught, a score is awarded based on the time taken, jewels recovered, guesses left, and letters still not exposed (in the clue to Dr. X's location).

424151.overview: The player has washed up on Science Island, and has only 400 hours to build a safe house before a major hurricane strikes. The player drives their car around the roads of Science Island, trying to drive to moving riddle signs. At each riddle sign, they can acquire memstones if they answer questions correctly. Each memstone can be used to build a part of the house. The player loses hours if they hit a wall, and also lose hours as they drive. There are hint signs on the side of the road that cost 2 hours to read. The player also encounters troll tolls, which can cost the player 20 hours if they answer a riddle incorrectly. If the player collects 20 stones and completes their cabin, they have the option to travel to the town and try to collect stones to build a townhouse. Doing this successfully, the player can travel to the Troll Forest, and try to gather memstones to build a castle.

447503.overview: The player controls a small rocket at the bottom of the screen, which can be scrolled left and right. On the top of the screen is a small alien saucer which moves horizontally at varying speeds and direction. The player's goal is to launch a missile and strike the alien vessel. The player gets a total of 15 missiles and 90 time units to try to destroy as many saucers as possible. The player's goal is to maximize score.

447504.overview:
Swarms is a simulation based on the book The Swarm by Arthur Herzog. As in the book killer bees are swarming the USA and the player is in control of the defense.

The player has multiple commands available to him:

Attack Scan Map - shows a map of the USA divided in sectors showing where bee attacks are taking place.
ETA Report - tells the player when bees are expected to reach a major city
Battle Phase Options - There are six different ways of combating the bees, it's up to the player to find out which options work best in which situation.
Evacuation - removes the population of a major city which is going to be attacked by bees.
Nuclear Destruction - nuke a city to rid it of all life.

447561.overview: Space Maze is a dexterity game where the player moves a space ship that looks like a TIE fighter through a maze-like course on a fixed screen trying to reach the finish without crashing into the walls.

447621.overview:
Seahunt is a collection of 3 games:-

1) Seahunt - Recover missing diamonds while avoiding the sea life.

2) J. Walker - Can you cross the road safely.

3) Galactic Glider - Galaxian type game.

448017.overview:
The player takes control of the U.S.S. Enterprise, as it defends the 64 quadrant Confederation from enemy Machiavellians during a limited time frame. The player must control the ship's limited energy while maintaining the health of their ship's systems. The player's ship is equipped with torpedoes and positron lasers. The player must warp to different sectors in search of enemy vessels, and can resupply at starbases.

The player is also able to beam down to individual planets to search for rare trilithium crystals which can improve the ship's energy usage.

448925.overview: Solitaire Poker is an adaptation of a video poker machine. The player starts out with placing a bet between one and seven dollars and then five cards are drawn. It's then possible to hold any number of cards before the other cards are redrawn. The objective is to have a winning hand of cards after the second drawn. There are nine different winning hands with different payouts: royal flush (500), straight flush (100), four of a kind (40), full house (10), flush (7), straight (5), three of a kind (3), two pair (2) and jacks or better (1).

448939.overview: Scientists Revenge is a fixed-screen 2D shooter where the player must destroy monsters as they stream from the beakers and flasks above. Winged daemons, disembodied heads, and other monstrosities swoop about, while firing towards the bottom of the screen. The player must move left and right to shoot at the creatures above, while avoiding incoming monster fire. If the player is hit, they are split in half, and lose a life. Lose three lives, and it's game over. If the player can destroy all creatures on the screen, they will advance to a more challenging level with faster months who fire more frequently.

448943.overview:
A collection of five games to exercise your strategy skills:-

1) Checkers
2) Skunk
3) UFO
4) Blockade
5) Genius

450147.overview:
As an anthropologist, you have come to Easter Island to study the customs, beliefs, and superstitions of its people. In the far distance an erupting volcano can be seen. The natives tell of an idol that can prevent the devastating eruption. You must search the island to find the idol and put it in its resting place before the island erupts, destroying the island. Legend has it that you will be rewarded with riches beyond your wildest dreams should you be successful in your task. Your materials and supplies have been lost in a storm prior to arrival, and you have arrived with only a gold ring and three dollars.

Secret of Easter Island is a color graphic adventure game where the player must type VERB NOUN commands. The game has a save/restore feature that allows the player to return to their game. The player must solve item based puzzles to accomplish the task. The player has a limited number of turns before the volcano erupts, ending the game.

The player starts in the beaches of Easter Island, and starts by exploring a small fishing village near the coast. The player must travel to the north, exploring deserts, jungles, and foreboding castles. The player must slay a dangerous salamander, throw a jellyfish at a poisonous spider, and crush a scorpion with a rock. The player finally turns a witch doctor into the aforementioned statue. The statue must then be brought deep within the volcano, and placed on a pedestal within the volcano, stopping the volcano from erupting. The player is rewarded with a large number of diamonds for their victory.

450150.overview:
Sieg in Afrika is a tactical war simulation based upon the North African campaign between the Axis and Allied forces during World War II.

Italy declared war on Great Britain and France on June 10, 1940. Mussolini immediately ordered his troops in Libya to advance into Egypt. With more that ten divisions in North Africa to the three Allied divisions, he foresaw no difficulties the Western desert forces in detail.

Designed for 1 - 2 players, each player controls the major land forces of either the Axis or Allied forces. A computer opponent is available for 1-player games. The viewpoint is from a corps level commander, and the player assigns movement and combat tasks for those groups, and responds to operational events.

The game is text-only, and came with a board and physical pieces to allow the player to keep track of the location of theirs and enemy units. All games begin in in June 1940, and progresses in 1 month intervals. Each break allows the player to input new commands for their forces. Each phase has an intelligence gathering component and a second component where troop orders can be given. Forces can be instructed to attack, break off, engage & destroy, hold, leaguer, move, rush, or search & sweep a location. The player must contend with limited fuel, food, and ammunition, and must make tactical decisions as to which units to reinforce.

At the end of each turn, the player receives radio reports from their troops and main command regarding current enemy troop locations and combat results.

450365.overview:
Sputnik Attack is a game similar to Galaga or Galaxian.

You control a spaceship, which task it is to destroy the oncoming forces of the evil Sputnik.

That's right, the satellite Sputnik became evil and sends now aliens of all kinds.

452597.overview:
This 1997 compilation Includes three games previously released by Infocom

The games included:

-  A Mind Forever Voyaging (1985)
-  Planetfall (1983)
-  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy (1984)

455535.overview:
Star Maze is a space-themed educational game teaching division.

Thid lives on the planet Mathid. The object of the game is to navigate a maze, and getting as many points as possible, while getting home within a time limit. The maze contains a number of stars, and whenever the player moves on a star, they must answer a division-related math question. If the player answers the question incorrectly, they are able to move on. The maze contains Goodid stars which act to increase the time remaining, while Badid stars move the player further from their goal. Game has 3 difficulty levels with differing mathematics problems.

455888.overview:
Sumer 4000 BC is a 1-player text-based strategy game set in ancient Sumeria.

Based upon the city building simulation Hammurabi, the player plays the role of the city's governor for a total of 10 years, in which their goal is to acquire 10,000 acres of land and 1,000,000 pieces of gold.

The player controls an army, which must be used to defend Sumerian lands, as well as gain control of foreign soil to create further lands to plant crops. Mobilizing the armies for offense costs large sums of gold. Each year, the player must choose how many acres of crops to plant, based upon the number of acres available, and the number of farmers or paid laborers ready to till the fields. Priests are useful for speaking directly to the gods, and each year a religious tithe must be paid to ensure good harvest, and avoid plague. The player sets the tax rate, which if too high will cause revolt. The city's population of traders are taxed, to earn the player gold at the end of each turn. The player can also purchase goods from the local Assyrians, which can be sold back at a later date, hopefully for a profit. Goods include: spices, iron, salt, skins, and wine, the prices of which vary yearly.

The player can choose how much wheat to keep in their storehouse, and how much to make available to the population. At the end of each year, if the player has excess food available, soldiers, farmers, and priests will flock to their city, increasing the population. If there is insufficient food, the population will plummet.

455890.overview: Star Voyager tasks the player with destroying a star base. The player must infiltrate their defenses using their space ship and after destroying the base the player has to return to Earth.

457062.overview:
Space Pirates 3000 is a strategy trading and combat game for the Apple II.

The player is a thief who has stolen a large sum of money from the bank on an alien planet. Being marketwise, you can buy ships and trading goods from the local marketplace, and can travel to other planets to trade items. The player can buy and combat a number of ships, including: scout ships, fighters, star cruisers, heavy star cruisers, and freighters. The player can combat enemy vessels to collect resources.

457091.overview:
Strategy Simulations is a series of unlicensed space themed strategy games.

Space Trek - Which is a Star Trek variant, where the player controls the USS Enterprize. The player's goal is to destroy all Klingon vessels in the surrounding star systems within 26 days. The player has a limited supply of phasors and photon torpedoes, and must travel to and explore different quadrants of space looking for enemies.

Galactic Empires - Up to 20 players compete to take over as many planets as possible in a randomly generated galaxy in a finite number of turns. Each player builds a set number of ships in their home planet each turn, and these ships are sent in fleets to conquer or protect alien planets.

Star Rebels - A 1 - 2 player space fighting game. Each player has 8 vessels, and the Rebels attempt to line up the small exhaust port on the Death Star to drop a torpedo. The Imperial player attempts to destroy 8 vessels before this happens. If the Rebels fail, the planet Yavin is destroyed.

Star Traders - A 2- 4 player interstellar stock trading game, players take turns placing pieces on a 12 x 9 board, and if 2 pieces are placed beside each other, a company is formed. Players are given 5 random locations to place a piece each turn. The player can buy or sell stocks in these companies, and if adjacent pieces are placed next to the company, the company grows in size and the stock price increases. The goal is to maximize profit.

457098.overview:
Shadow Hawk One is a first person space shooter and strategy game.

The Galactic Empire has just conquered the Noble Free Space Confederation, except for a remote moon on the outskirts of the empire. Using your warship's unmatched speed, you prey on the Galactic Empire's merchant fleet to gather raw materials to better your ship's weaponry, shielding, and missiles. Your goal is to sack the Galactic Empire's merchants and destroy their warships.

The player moves about the galaxy map by selecting a location. The map shows the location of enemy warships, planets, bases, and locations to resupply. The player can place beacons, which allows them to find enemy merchant vessels. When the player destroys enemy merchant ships, they gain resources, which can be used to increase shield, hull, disruptor, or torpedo strength, purchase more beacons or torpedos, or repair vehicle damage. Combat takes place from a 1st person point of view, where the player must line up enemy vessels in the center of their crosshairs to fire upon the enemy. When the player's ship is destroyed, it's game over. The player receives a score and a rank at the end of their adventure based upon the number of enemy ships destroyed, ranging from ground pounder to starlord.

457104.overview:
Strategic Craps is a betting simulator and craps game.

Designed to teach players the game of craps, and help them improve their technique. Numerous betting strategies and tutorials are embedded within the game, and the player can also play individual games of craps to test their technique. The craps board is graphically displayed on the screen during gameplay.

The player can also create a craps strategy, where they bet specific ways for different rolls and situations. The player can then simulate a number of rounds to see how their strategy performs, and their expected gambling returns.

457106.overview:
Saturn Navigator is an entry in subLOGIC's Flight Simulator series (A2-3DA) and considered an expansion to the original game, though it is a stand-alone title that does not require the original Flight Simulator disk to function. It simulates a trip from Earth in a rocket-propelled spacecraft to rendezvous with an imaginary Saturn-orbiting space station.

The game is extremely complex and based around scientific principles of spaceflight. It was actually created by a scientist at Jet Propulsion Laboratories. The four stages of the game are: Transorbit, Approach, Orbit and Rendezvous.

457111.overview: Learn to compose and write music.

457175.overview:
Star Avenger is a 1-player space-themed arcade shooter for the Apple II.

The player controls a spaceship which can fly and fire in 360 degrees using the Apple Paddles. The player moves about a 4 x 4 grid, and has a map to help locate their position and that of their opponent, a star-shaped alien vessel which will intermittently buzz the player and fire upon them. The player and computer opponent fire upon each other, in an attempt to destroy each other. There are 3 difficulty settings, and 3 game length scenarios which determine the starting health of the player and their opponent. When one player loses all power, they are destroyed.

460266.overview:
Star Clones is a series of four 1 - 4 player Star Wars-themed mini-games. All games are controlled via the Apple Paddles.

The player can either do a mission, where they attempt to beat all 4 mini-games in order, or the player can focus on practicing a single mini-game.

In Clone Trooper Onslaught, the player controls a small turret on the bottom center of the screen, while a number of clone troopers attempt to march past the player. The player must shoot all of the clones before they march off the bottom of the screen, or the game is lost.

In Attack of the Metal Monsters, the player controls a small craft that continuously flies from the right of the screen, while a large metal 4-legged robot approaches from the right. The player must attempt to swoop in and shoot the poorly protected view-port without striking the metal attacker or getting shot down.

In Desert Scout Daredevil, the player must carefully control the speed of their landspeeder to attempt to jump a chasm of angry robots, and land on the down ramp on the other side. The gap becomes longer with each successful jump.

In Assault on Star Clone City, the player most moves vertically up and down on the left of the screen, while avoiding asteroids and enemy vessels which approach rapidly from the right. If they survive long enough, they have the chance to engage Star Clone City.

471800.overview:
This educational title aims to test your knowledge of the geography of the USA as a game. The country is shown as a map with all the states. It is possible to practice first to study the state names and the names of their capitals before playing the game

There are three game modes:Play States*

The player sits in the car and the computer proposes the route by giving names of start and end states. Starting in the "start state", the player has to type in the name of the next state to visit. The trip should be finished in time (optionally). Incorrect names of states exhaust the available time. The trip itself also deducts time, taking into account time zones, night stops, and the time needed to travel. If the player reaches the end state in time, the thematic picture of this state is shown.

Play Capitals
Completely identical in gameplay to Play States, but with capitals as start and ending points.

Play Quiz Game
The player selects one of the quiz themes, and chooses the appropriate state that is the answer, after receiving the question. The themes are: + Abbreviations (3 kinds); + Artists; + Birds (4 kinds); + Bridges; + Cities; + Colleges; + Facts; + Flowers (4 kinds); + Folktale; + Geography (2 kinds); + Government; + History; + Indian (3 kinds); + Lakes; + Landmark; + Mottos (4 kinds); + Nicknames (9 kinds); + People (3 kinds); + Places; + Pop; + Presidents (2 kinds); + Products; + Signers; + Species; + Sports; + Trivia (10 kinds); + Waterway; + Women.

All actions are controlled with the keyboard.

471829.overview: Star Explorer is not a wargame but, well, a space exploration game – think early Star Trek, but without the episodes where Captain Kirk needs to find a traitor among the crew. After choosing if you want to do only one exploration run or a full campaign, you pick your ship:

471831.overview: The player control's Santa's sleigh, led by Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer. The sleigh can move slowly up and down on the right side of the screen, while chimneys scroll by on the bottom of the screen. Rudolph's red nose serves as a laser that can shoot down approaching objects. The player must shoot or avoid birds, stars, and other objects that move slowly from the left of the screen. If the player is hit by these objects, they lose a life. There are three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium and Hard. They player starts with 3 Santa's in total. The goal is to maximize score.

481560.overview: This is a mainly text based interactive history lesson, don't expect any arcade thrills or pirating glory. But if you've got any interest in knowing a little bit more about early European explorers, or would like to test your knowledge, or have kids who like history, then this is definitely worth checking out. There are 4 game modes and 30 featured explorers, choosing the first game mode, will let you choose an explorer and read some key facts about them, and show the routes they took on the map. This knowledge you can use to try to get points in the other game modes. For example a game loosely based on Poker, where you try to pair explorers by the countries they sailed for, which you can play against another player, or the computer. Other game modes have you try to match the facts with the relevant explorer, or try to guess the explorer from the least amount of clues possible. For example: Who destroyed the Aztec capital, founded Mexico City, and took the gold and silver back to Spain?. It was fun to learn more about Christopher Columbus, often credited as being the first European explorer to discover North America, he believed all his life that he'd discovered the Orient. And settlements had been founded much earlier by viking raiders and explorers. James Cook was killed by native Hawaiians in a scuffle over a stolen board, after they first believed him to be a god. It seems like life expectancy of these early explorers tended to be quite short.
